text: Developers can create a free sandbox account to get API keys and test the API safely
quote: create a free Developer Sandbox account. This provides access to the Developer Sandbox where you can create and manage API keys, and safely test the API

text: API access is authenticated via HTTP Basic Auth using an API Key ID and Secret Key
quote: Call the `ping` endpoint using HTTP Basic Auth, providing your API Key ID as the username, and the API Secret Key as the password.

text: A public API endpoint lists all available accounts
quote: Get a list of all the available accounts using the `account` endpoint.

text: Bank account opening is done via a multi-step API flow: person application, business application, then account application
quote: To apply to open a new bank account 1. Create a Person Application 2. Create a Business Application ... 5. Create an Account Application

text: Programs can integrate a bank-approved third-party KYC/KYB vendor into account opening
quote: Programs can seamlessly integrate their bank-approved third-party KYC/KYB vendor into the account opening process.

text: Incremental KYC allows running identity verification without opening an account
quote: Incremental KYC lets you run KYC **without opening an account**.

text: ACH credits push funds to a recipient and ACH debits pull funds from an external account
quote: An ACH credit is used when you wish to send or "push" funds to a recipient. ... An ACH debit is used when you wish to "pull" funds from an external account.

text: Originated ACH transfers can be returned via an Update ACH endpoint
quote: To return an ACH transfer you originated, use the Update an ACH endpoint.

text: Wire transfer progress can be tracked via a status attribute on the Wire Transfer object
quote: You can track the progress of a wire by checking the `status` attribute on the Wire Transfer object.

text: Instant payment rails settle funds within seconds, 24/7/365
quote: Instant Settlement: Payments settle within seconds, 24/7/365

text: Book transfers move funds electronically between two accounts at the same bank, and are the fastest and cheapest transfer type
quote: A book transfer is an electronic funds transfer between two accounts at the same bank... Book transfers are the fastest and cheapest type of transfer

text: A Postman Collection is provided to speed up initial API exploration and testing
quote: you can do your testing as in command line or using our Postman Collection to speed up your initial exploration of our APIs.

text: Branded monthly account statements can be generated and retrieved for customers
quote: Generate and retrieve branded monthly account statements for your customers.

text: Customers can add cash to their accounts at 90,000+ retail locations nationwide
quote: Enable customers to add funds to their accounts using cash at 90,000+ retail locations nationwide

text: The platform integrates directly and in real time with existing technology stacks without requiring replacement
quote: Simplify and enhance your existing technology stack through direct, real-time and seamless integration. Don't rip and replace it.
